integrity: The supplied standalone reproducibility code defines the graph and performs complete checks; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only the ordinary matching complex of the fixed labeled Pappus graph. Exhaustive graph-specific computation, a fully checked discrete-Morse certificate, and an integral three-column boundary witness establish the homotopy type; this does not classify all cubic graph matching complexes. Index-based prior-art searching may miss an equivalent unindexed result.
title: Integral homotopy type of the Pappus graph matching complex
